# RoomKaki

> Trust-first room and flatshare rentals in Singapore. Owner-direct listings from verified posters, MRT-smart search, and a scam-safe contact-reveal flow. Serves English, Burmese (မြန်မာ), and more.

RoomKaki is a Singapore-focused platform for finding and posting rooms and flatshares **directly with owners** — no agent fees. Every poster is verified, contact details are revealed through a logged, scam-safe flow, and search is organised around MRT lines and neighbourhoods. It is built for renters who have been burned by scams or opaque agents, including migrant and student communities.

## Key facts
- Location served: Singapore
- Model: owner-direct (no middleman agent), trust-first, verified posters
- Search: by MRT line, price, room type, move-in date
- Languages: English, Burmese (မြန်မာ), more coming
- Cost: free to browse, free to post
- Safety: contact reveal is logged; listings are moderated before going live

## Main pages
- [Home / search](https://roomkaki.com/): browse and search verified listings on a map
- [Post a room](https://roomkaki.com/): owners list a room (login required)

## Contact
Feedback and suggestions are welcome via the on-site "tell us what to add" form.
